title: Crime Reports: Multiple thefts reported in Abilene - NewsBreak
text:
By Nick Bradshaw ,
8 hours ago
Editor’s Note: The Abilene Police Department supplied the following arrest and incident reports. All information below is based on reports made by responding officers, and all suspects are considered innocent unless proven guilty in a court of law.
Incidents 5100 block of Spring Creek – Theft of Property
Report taken for possible theft on the south side of town.
3300 block of Spanish Street – Evading Arrest
A report was taken for evading on the north side of Abilene.
800 block of Grape Street – Theft of Property
Abilene police responded to a suspicious person call at a North Abilene convenience store.
5300 block of Pueblo Drive – Harassment
Police took a report.
500 block of Cypress Street – Forgery in Progress
Forgery – Financial $750-$2,500
3100 Block of South 1st Street – Assault in Progress
Police dispatched to a north side business for a disturbance.
1300 Block of Danville Drive – Aggravated Assault with a deadly weapon Family Violence
A man was allegedly assaulted by a known suspect at his job.
Arrests Hailey Butcher – Assault
Jessica Luna – Arrest Warrant
Quade Darby – Driving While Intoxicated
